gaps.explanation: Proprietary fund statement p6 (printed p10) has Enterprise Fund and Debt Service Fund columns; detail[] has only the utility funds combining schedule p10 (= the Enterprise Fund). Debt Service Fund column nonoperating revenues: Interest Income 408 and Miscellaneous Income 6 (Total 2,462 = 2,054 + 408; 2,690 = 2,684 + 6). Schedule 1,115,012 + 408 + 6 = 1,115,426 = statement. The Debt Service Fund column also prints Transfers In From Enterprise Fund 106,853; there is no business-type transfers gap row, so it is added here (section other financing, not part of the revenue arithmetic): detail transfers net then = Enterprise (161,056) (existing line) + 106,853 = (54,203) = the p6 Total column.
